H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H3225: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H7896: to place (in a very wide application)
H7272: a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda
H4294: a branch (as extending); figuratively, a tribe; also a rod, whether for chastising (figuratively, correction), ruling (a sceptre), throwing (a lance), or walking (a staff; figuratively, a support of life, e.g. bread)
H5797: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
H6726: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
H7287: to tread down, i.e. subjugate; specifically, to crumble off
H7130: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H5071: properly (abstractly) spontaneity, or (adjectively) spontaneous; also (concretely) a spontaneous or (by inference, in plural) abundant gift
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H2428: probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H7650: to seven oneself, i.e. swear (as if by repeating a declaration seven times)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H5162: properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself)
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H3548: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H4442: Malki-Tsedek, an early king in Palestine
H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H4272: to dash asunder; by implication, to crush, smash or violently plunge; figuratively, to subdue or destroy
H639: properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire
H1777: a straight course, i.e. sail direct
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H4390: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)
H1472: a body, whether alive or dead
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H5158: a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine)
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
